what_i_found: The HUD is not a HUD: the controls are cards you physically carry, drag into sockets in the world, and tune from the socket. BRIGHTNESS and GRAVITY change the room itself (dim to read hidden order, radiant to build the bridge, heavy to freeze drifting anchors), so every puzzle is solved by choosing a setting and paying its time cost. The final challenge socketed both cards side by side, so two settings have to be sequenced together.
